notes.title: Act II - Expanding Gameplay Mechanics Update
notes.content:
Map Expansion
Now you'll be able to enter the walled city to meet new characters and embark on new adventures, and we will be adding more in upcoming updates.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44549581/008d9671177cef3ccdfb606ab979c94ea8744eaf.png

Mounts and Vehicles
In this update, we introduce the horse for faster travel around the world, and in future updates, we will include new vehicles.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44549581/a20e11976a47dd3cf52bbef94527824bc07c78f9.gif

Achievements
We've added achievements, and it's likely that we will add a few more in the upcoming updates.

Hunger and Health
We've incorporated health and hunger for your character. Now, you can buy food at market stalls or collect fruits in the world to avoid starving. Additionally, we are introducing items that will enhance character attributes or assist us in completing certain types of quests.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44549581/1fb83011db59815c3bc2119503ceeb167fa67a2e.png

Cooking
In addition to basic food, you can use ingredients to prepare dishes or buy them at the tavern.

Clothing
For now, it only serves cosmetic purposes, but in future updates, it will affect gameplay. For example, wearing a Guard outfit to go unnoticed in some quests.

Sleeping Bag
Sometimes it's inconvenient to have to return home just to sleep, so we've introduced a sleeping bag that you can purchase at various locations on the map. Use it anywhere to wait for night or day.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44549581/ff0ad81eb40827afb5a16fa851020186b6f1d6bf.png

Housing
As you earn more coins, you'll be able to acquire one of the new properties we've added to the map.

New Types of Quests
We continue to create new types of missions. Now, you'll have to search for the items of the order to deliver them. We'll keep working on increasing the variety and quantity in future updates.
